description:
**Dimension: msrv · 2 findings (1 medium, 1 low)** — see report §msrv.

- (med) `crates/gf2-kernels-simd/Cargo.toml` — no `rust-version` field; all peer crates declare `rust-version = "1.95"`. Without it `cargo check --locked` silently accepts older toolchains for this crate. Add `rust-version = "1.95"` to `[package]`.
- (low) `AGENTS.md` — MSRV section omits `gf2-algebra` and `gf2-sim` and does not flag the missing pin. Update the sentence to list all enforcing crates (after the fix above, gf2-kernels-simd is pinned too).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `gf2-kernels-simd/Cargo.toml` declares `rust-version = "1.95"`.
- [hard] REQ-02: AGENTS.md MSRV sentence lists every crate that pins 1.95, consistent with reality post-fix.
- [hard] REQ-03: `rustup run 1.95.0 cargo check -p gf2-kernels-simd` succeeds; fmt clean.
title: Pin MSRV 1.95 on gf2-kernels-simd and align CLAUDE.md
